I found something mildly interesting: there are a few times that dialogue is redacted in the game, but can actually be seen in comments in the script itself. I wouldn't be surprised if this was already known, but a rudimentary thread search didn't turn up anything.


Comment: "LIKE HERS???"

If you input "Son" as your lust name for Sara:



"Why?"



"Why that, of all things?"



"It seems like just yesterday I was bathing him in the kitchen sink"
"Do you have any idea what it's like to bury a child, Sensei?"
"Do you have any idea how hard it is?"
"Why didn't you just fuck me?"
"Fuck me and make the pain go away"
"That's all there is anymore"


Translation: "why does everything have to hurt so much" (Vigenere cipher with key "XXX")



"WHY NOW?! THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE OVER!"

Sara used to be visited by figures like this during the period when she was having blackouts ("Halfway Down the Wishing Well"):

The last one is somewhat interesting to me, since it confirms that Sara told the truth when she said that her "hallucinations" stopped at some point - but now they've started again and she's hiding that fact.

I wonder if there's a reason that Selebus chose these three scenes in particular out of all of the many instances of redacted dialogue. Is this related to the self-referential narrative of the game Lessons in Love as it exists within the story? (probably not)

Finally, here's a fun little Easter egg that also involves a comment.
Molly talks about hidden flags and how they can have unforeseen effects on a game's outcome.



In the middle of these lines, the script sets the flag hiddenmollyflagwhatdoesitmean followed by the comment "shhhhhdonttellakiralmao".
This event is unmissable and the flag is always set, so it can't have any meaningful effect going forward, it's just there as a joke.
I'm pretty sure these are the only interesting comments in the files, I searched for them after stumbling across the one in "Goodnight".

does using URM trigger the cheater flag? I'd probably only use it for the 3000 ayane lust things because that sounds ridiculous
Click to expand...
Not inherently, URM itself will never trigger cheater flags. Now if you make a change that Sel suspects to be URM only (Or gets lazily anal about certain stats being too high too quickly) nothing's stopping him for putting a check for that during a random update.

Unless you're committing to editing the value to 3000 and keeping it at least that high, you should probably just read the dialogue, then roll back to what you'd normally get. You're much more likely to get hit by a cheater check if you have flags for event paths that you lack the flags to have reached in the first place.

So far the only uses of the cheater flag I know of are actually using the cheats in the cheat menu. There were mentions of it being set the Ch1 Himawari event but those turned out to only be if you had edited your stats using the cheats to view the option in the first place.

posts.content_html_raw:
Just reached the Inai Inai Baa scene for the first time and the following Makoto and Futaba confrontation...man. I just wanted to share my thoughts.

It's fascinating how this story seems to be flipping the harem trope on it's head.
MC is a harem protagonist in every sense. All the girls love him, he gets away with doing heinous shit. Its paradise....except its not...

He doesnt think he deserves this in any way, as a matter of fact it fucks him up. He wants to be hated, he wants bad things to happen to him. I think that's a big reason why the hallucinatory/glitchy scenes are called "Happy" scenes in the lore/wiki. These are the only times where he is feeling like he is getting what he deserves. It feels to me that in a twisted way this world, this game, or whatever it is, is actually a hell for him in many ways, and not just simply because of the trauma and dark twists. Subconsciously or not, he's rejecting the good parts. Why do all these girls love me, why do I get away with this everything, why isn't anyone stopping me.

Makes even more sense why he's so attracted towards Maya from the beginning even disregarding their mysterious history. Her telling him off is exactly what he wants deep down. Gives me a new PERSPECTIVE

Man.....it's fucking me up in all the right ways and I can't get enough.

I think people should (generally) take harsh comments about Ami with a grain of salt.
I can obviously only speak for myself, but that Ami has a daughter arc speaks volumes for who she could be with proper care. Himawari assures Ayane that our Ami would never hurt her, and the Ami from the Special Ami Happy Event also assures us that none of the bizarre stuff is her. I think what people really are violently opposed to is the dynamic between Akira and Ami, in which the adult leaves it all up to the deranged mental kid (which led to everything Ami became).

The real issue with Ami is Akira, simply put (granted that she just blackouts him and takes advantage of his mental state when he tries to confront her a couple of times, but yeah, that is also his fault for not developing a better coping mechanism after so many years). Also, we don't even know who Ami is and her relation to the overall TERMINAL 23 stuff. At the moment, if Selebus pulled an "Ami actually never existed", I'd have to go with "yeah, I can sort of see that". Same for Himawari actually being Ami, or Ami being a previous TEMPLATE for both Maya and Nao-chan, I just don't know.
Fact of the matter is that Ami does a lot of fucked up shit. But so do a lot of the characters. Or they likely would if they had enough awareness throughout the cycles to do it, as Ami and Maya did. So on the one hand I can sort of understand her, but on the other I also dislike her because, well, that's the natural response for someone doing fucked up shit to people I like.

posts.content_html_raw:
Dear You.
I'm writing this even though I have nowhere to send it. I'm sure I'll think it's
stupid in hindsight but if it helps me get over the fact that I can't see you
now. when I want to the most. it will be at least partially worth it. So... where
to begin.
i remember the first time you came over to- NO!
Do you remember the first time we- FUCK!!

I miss you so much.
Fuck writing letters

Dear You.
I'm stronger now. I only think about you for like 75% of every day. soooooo that's an improvement.

I had that dream again. The one where we all go to the city and you wind up proposing in front of my parents.
It seems so ridiculous to be having that NOW when it's been... I don't even know how long since we last talked.

Anyway. I hope you're eating well. I'm sure it must be hard even if you never particularly cared about your brother.
My parents miss you. Noriko misses you.
And of course...
Yeah.
Anyway. I'll be here if you need me.

- Niki

Dear You.
I fucking hate you. I hate you so so so so so so much.
It's unfucking fair that you just up and left when you KNOW that I would do
ANYTHING to even TRY to help you feel better. Do you have any idea how I feel not
being able to see you? Not having anyone to call before I go to bed? I can't even fucking open
Dragon Quest anymore because it was OUR save file and I don't want to KEEP
PLAYING WITHOUT YOU FUCK WHY ARE YOU NOT HERE.

PLEASE COME HOME

- The girl you left behind

Dear You.
My parents found out I've been writing letters to no one. They want me to talk to someone and
like...get help or whatever. I might. I don't know. It's a lot to take in.

How is Ami? I hope you two are getting along well. Noriko and I got into a fight over one of your old
t-shirts. I came home from school (I started going again) and saw that she stretched out the collar.
I slapped her in the face and she started crying but I never got in trouble for it. My parents probably
feel bad.

It still smells like you.

...

- Fuck

Dear You.
I've forgotten how many of these things I've written for you. but this might be the last.
I've been practicing my singing and dancing (You can make fun of me later) and I... think I was
scouted? I have an interview thing tomorrow and if it all goes well. I'll have to start focusing a lot
harder on...
Being away from you.

THIS IS YOUR LAST CHANCE
PLEASE CHECK THIS BOX IF YOU ARE COMING HOME
I'LL DROP IT ALL FOR YOU
                         I MEAN IT     I MISS YOU    GO FUC‎‎‎KYOURSELF
                     PLEASE        ☐           ☐‎
Niki Nakayama (In case you forgot)                           

VoidExile

Man those letters tickle my brain just right. And now I get the best event chain after Christmas 2 for that effort. Getting that 5th letter to format correctly was quite a bitch.

Day 35 character count 9335. (is calling it "character count" even grammatically correct?)
Patriarchy = his penis. Hmm... I don't think I understand.

Why can't I remember him going to another restaurant with Niki that wasn't for the sausage fest?

Imagine if the accident Kaori had spawned multiple clones of herself and they all have telepathic communication with each other so they know how to avoid him at all times. Sorry, don't mind me. Just impressed by how Kaori manages to appear in every restaurant he visits at the same time.

I... that's a good question. How IS she balancing wine glasses on a plate sideways?

The number of statics in this scene makes it seem like Noriko is pushing the border of what his mind can handle.
Uh oh, you know it's not good when [redacted] starts appearing in her conversation and the world starts glitching.

Wtf? Is Maya at the beach right now? I would love to believe that from Maya perspective in the game world, he just spawned out of nowhere and freaked the fuck out of her before disappearing again.

Holy fuck, Niki is sucking up to Ami real good! The fucking generosity to bring two bags of clothes and merch etc to one of your big fans.

I'm pretty sure the mc CAN take credit for Niki becoming an idol. Pretty easily too on account of the idol industry forbidding relationships. Niki can't get away with this argument in my eyes.

Niki gonna have to stop being so toxic about being abandoned by a man who no longer remembers why he did it. I somehow don't think he was the one responsible. Pair this with the fact she's only an idol because he left her, she owes her success to a man with severe memory issues who left her so she would grow.

You know I'm starting to think Niki's "pet name" is whatever you told the manager... so Barack in this case. Which is fucking weird btw... Imagine moaning the name of a president during sex when that president has nothing to do with either of you.

If I didn't know any better I would think that is Ayane on the covers of that manga on account of the long blonde hair and what looks like it could be blue eyes... but I can't really tell and I also don't know any better despite what I said at the start.

Headpat noodles? Huh. How long has that been an option?

I do that... I just casually reads porn without doing anything about it.
Honestly if someone were to ask me why I read AVN's instead of normal VN's I would tell them that there is nothing I look forward to in normal visual novels as the porn is the reward. Oftentimes however, the porn isn't good enough to get off to however. So you may then make the assumption I play any visual regardless of art style as long as the tags are good but nope, that is not the case. Or you might make the assumption I only play visual novels with good preview images to get off to which is also not the case. Really, it's all about AVN's with animations and preferrable art styles and tags, nothing less.

OMG, was that her? I've seen that subreddit post read on YT before several times. Someone needed help with their math homework and people actually helped them.

So... I guess the mc has ASPD then?

Wtf is going on right now? Is Kirin actually the moral polar opposite of Rin? They both have the wingman personality but Kirin approaches things in an evil way.

Damn dude, that escalated quickly... and weirdly. He lost control, restrained her, didn't want to take advantage of her and leave, she wouldn't have it, blackmails him into doing it anyway.

Visiting Ayane at the dojo right now yields some interesting switches to dialogue since Osako is not there to focus on the dojo. You know I love reactions, so not seeing Osako's reaction to Wakana in that state was kinda shitty... I wonder if that's a sadistic wish or not. Probably not given some unmentioned conditions. Also, I still haven't seen that hang out with Osako at the dojo because of the timing of everything, the one that autovn revealed by mistake.

Welp. This is my life now. Patting a virtual bird whose caws the mc can understand in an avn where 500 pats = orgasm.
This bird is fucking scary. What personality would you call that? The doomsayer personality paired with the religious fanatic? Same thing maybe.
I can't even see how many pats in I am, so if this really goes to 500, I will be completely in the dark how close I am. Maybe URM has a counter for it I can find, but I've put URM on the second copy of the game hosting the packages.
How the hell does this bird know about the niece fingering? I demand answers! (but not spoilers... although I don't see why the fuck there would be more story for this bird that would somehow give that information... maybe this is the third god, who knows.)
Oh and also I guess the bird might just be giving me the count itself.

This bird is giving me too many new words I've never seen before and I don't know how to feel about this the fact a virtual bird is smarter than me.
The bird is telling me to turn back in caesar cipher. Great.
Oh fuck... The bird is now breaking reality itself. I'm not sure I like where this is going, but I'm all here for it so no backing down now.
Don't tell me what to do, bird!
I don't think the bird is gonna tell me what count I'm on.
Reality didn't break earlier because the bird said something that made him remember, did it? I don't even know, I will just keep patting the bird.

The bird is evolving, shale I be concerned? (evolving = about to take flight)
Is mother bird about to show up? His about to get destroyed, isn't he?
Wait... that's it? Did I at least unlock something? Don't see anything in unlockables. Maybe time will tell what headpatting a bird 500 times will do.

In other news, Chika lives in blissful ignorance and only remembers what she wants to remember.
Chika is so fucking ignorant about this... Refuses to believe that he dated Niki.
I'm starting to see cracks in Chika's otherwise perfect exterior. Obsessive, doesn't listen, jumps to conclusions, among other things.

Niki coming to terms with her bossyness, probably caused by her idol lifestyle.
Welp. The second invite over event for Niki. Here's hoping it won't be too startling.
Given that they are watching a horror movie right now, that scare could happen whenever. But I doubt it will be any worse than at the ramen shop(is it a ramen shop or a ramen restauraunt? What's even the difference?)
Damn, I'm disappointed now! Wtf was that? I didn't need to be warned about that at all.

Expected an animated blowjob from Niki, got fingering. Of coures I can't expect the game to meet my expectations.

Wth... he talks during Niki headpatting? I don't know if I like this new development. I'm pretty certain his never talked during it before.
Double facial expression transition too. That's 2 first now.
She's so fucking pissed due...

I can't facepalm any harder than I already am right now... ARE YOU FUCKING SERIOUS!? Yuki tried to give her daughter a phone case TO PROTECT IT FROM GETTING WET or damaged as well as some gift cards. She was just a little too late and even if she wasn't, Yumi still chose to throw it away without even looking. But fucking seriously... Fuck dude, I don't even know.

I reminded myself that I can manually call Yumi's phone and lo and behold, Yumi's phone is indeed broken and can't be called.

No matter how you look at it, Kaori shouldn't be able to maintain that many jobs. The laws of physics don't allow it.

I kinda hope both the mc and Yuki remain blissfully unaware of what Yumi did to the present. There is certainly a sense of irony to her losing her phone before getting the gift so if she does end up getting a new phone, I imagine the mc will get suspicious if he doesn't see the case on it after some time.

Yumi finding him and her mother together can only go badly, but it's like almost everything goes badly with Yuki so, fair.
NICE, calling it a date, hmm. Well, she didn't bite.
For someone so determined to stay away from her mother, Yumi is being awfully talkative this time around.
Oh, it's because he is Chika's boyfriend or whatever. Still weird tho.

... So that thing about hoping the mc and Yuki never find out what Yumi did with the present, well that didn't last long.

Yumi slapping her own mother... playing with fire there.
HOLY FUCK! Why did I not react when Yumi slapped her mother but I reacted when Yuki slapped Yumi back after Yumi accused them of fucking?
Are you a bad mother for slapping your daughter for accusing you of sleeping with her teacher? I feel like under that context, Yumi had it coming.

Honestly, I think that went great. Yumi needs to chill the fuck out. She was the one acting like a baby in that entire situation, Yuki was the one taking it. Just wish Yuki had confirmed how long she hasn't been doing drugs or whatever it was. If Yumi could just learn to forgive her mother and show some respect, they could repair the relationship in no time. I see no way Yuki would throw away the opportunity.

And I'm just now realizing that was indeed a Yuki event. I mean 50/50 Yumi and Yuki.

When Yumi were in her crying, eyes closed, not even a feet apart, basically taunting him to abuse her state, I was thinking, I wonder what would happen if he either head patted her or attempted to get her tears off her face? Given Yumi's hatred for feeling humiliated and thus becoming angry as a defense mechanism, I can only imagine she would have snapped from that.

I've spent some time thinking about Ami through a Monika and DDLC lens. It's surprisingly interesting and makes certain things fit into place neatly. However, as discussing these thoughts will spoil DDLC, I must mark it as a spoiler for both LiL and DDLC. As a reminder all of this is for fun and not an attempt to authoritatively explain elements.

First of all, let's wholly supplant the DDLC setting into LiL and then imagine Ami as a Monika figure. The situation then would be that Lessons in Love is canonically an eroge which we are playing. The heroines would all be Lessons in Love characters. Ami would be unique in that she is self-aware of being a game character. We would imagine that she has various powers over the others either due to this or due to something else: perhaps she can edit lust values, affection values, etc.

From there, we can draw interesting parallels. We can imagine a situation where, like Monika wasn't given a route for whatever reason, Ami wasn't given a route due to being a niece or daughter; she could be lashing out against the game as a result. This is reinforced by various lines about an Ami route and so on.

At this point a question arose in my mind: who, exactly, is Ami in love with? Monika was in love with 'the player,' but I don't think this is the case in LiL (although it could be quaint). This is where I pivot to thinking about Sensei's role in such a game.

DDLC didn't go too deep into the protagonist himself from my recollection, so this is mostly spitballing. I may want to replay it. Anyway, an interesting consideration could be that Akira lived a full life within the universe of LiL, but then had his agency robbed for the sole purpose of becoming he protagonist. This is actually pretty interesting: it's always the case in eroge that the protagonist lived an entire life, then suddenly the player comes and starts making choices for them. A duality I've thought about before on its own is "Sensei = protagonist, Akira = person." All that stuff at the start of the game about someone 'taking over the body' of Sensei could actually be considered rather legitimate, with the player abruptly 'taking over control' of Akira.

Now, an interesting consideration is that it may be that Ami loves Akira but hates the player for taking him over. Alternatively, she doesn't care for Akira, but she loves Sensei, the self-insert shell. Finally, there is the consideration that Akira *IS* the player and Sensei was always a shell, but Akira (the player)'s real life is bleeding into the game. There's a different lot of interpretations here, but I think this is where (if Monika inspiration was being drawn despite Monika not being in the list of 3 inspirations for Ami he posted on discord) LiL would be distinguishing itself from DDLC. I think the most likely, or most compelling, is Ami loving the empty shell. We see in Ch4 she is very happy when he is in a shattered state and not being piloted by the player.

To bring back the 'Ami manipulating the game' thing for a moment, I think there could be two interesting applications here: one, raising Sensei's lust so he rapes her immediately, and two, editing/manipulating memory so he forgets things. It fits surprisingly well to imagine her perfectly engineering the opening of the game, and perhaps deleting Maya if Maya ever gets too close to 'fixing' Sensei (the ideal protagonist) or otherwise fully stealing away Sensei's affection.

Most exciting of all, though, is that this leads into an explanation about Maya being 'not from' Kumonmi, or like, 'an outsider' - we could say she's the one person who's not a game character, but entered the game alongside the protagonist by some means. I feel like Maya's outsiderness has always been one of the most perplexing elements of Lessons in Love, in that it's something referenced and clearly important, yet almost entirely opaque to us. It works if we imagine Akira leaping off a roof into Sensei's body, and then Maya following into the game.

Another pleasing element is that it can explain our own presence. In one interpretation, it may be that we're accessing the game and trying to control Sensei, making an enemy of Ami who wants empty shell Sensei. It may be that we're fighting for control over Sensei with the player named Akira. Alternatively, we could be fighting for control over Akira with unknown other players. Football Sensei feels like an oblique nod to the differing playstyle preferences of different players; if someone else played Lessons in Love and piloted Sensei, they might end up just doing nothing but fucking Ami/Karin while watching Football. Fair enough.

I like the idea of Akira having a history internal to the game, and this Sensei business being an exploration of what happens when someone's agency is denied to turn them into a generic protagonist, but it does conflict with Maya's devotion to an extent; she has history with Akira, explicitly, so it doesn't make sense for her to be 'an outsider' if that's all part of the game, and basically just works better if Akira is someone from outside the game. I do like the idea of the external world leaking into the game, though.

Anyway, that's some brief thoughts on possible DDLC-based inspiration or frameworks. I don't really mean much by this, it's just fun to think about.

Some rambling about my harsh word against Ami, and if you don't want to be spoil, since I'll not contain my way of word, don't open the spoiler.
Good? Here we go!
The main reason why I'm that way against Ami is mostly because I, maybe we, don't know what she is. And what is her objective. Is she a God? A «reincarnation» of her mother? Or just a girl who know too much?
And why did she see Maya as a «menace»?
I don't understand her, and that is why I consider her as a serious menace.

Anyway, as those questions remaining without any answers, I made some thinking about what she might be :
- If she is a God, or a strange deity, that will be the worst scenario. Since killing her will be inefficient and ineffective. Sensei will have to forget her completely if he want her to disappear... good luck for that!
- If she is a somewhat «reincarnation» of Sekai, the problem will be the same as above, but slightly different, since Sensei will be able to «keep» her under control. Like by putting her in a box/ironmaiden.
- And if she is just a girl who know too much, that will be the easiest to deal with.

At that I got an idea : can we hard reset her? Since we learn, if my memory don't fail me, that when someone died, they are hard reset. Physically AND mentally. I guess that was the reason why every girls were virgin at the beginning of the game, well, every girls except those with a cruel life past.
And that's why I have preconized a bath of boiling tar. Not because is cruel... ok, maybe a little, but there's some logic behind it, I swear!
The logic is quite simple :
- If she is indeed a God, or a «reincarnation» of Sekai, then Sensei gonna learn a lot of thing. Like : Can she died? Can he flee from her? What is the extention of her power? Etc. A lot of precious information he can use for the upcoming loop.

posts.content_html_raw:
My god it took me forever to understand something so simple. Akira needs to take something that does not belong to him, because Sekai took something from him that didn't belong to her.
What this calls into question, however, is why would HOPE, Wires and Pareidolia all need something that it so specific to Akira's trauma. The reason to why Akira needs to rape his sacrifices is because he was raped by Sekai. Well, we know gods, in general, don't need that at all - they just need to be believed in and provide a function, it's a two way street.

So what is going on here? For Pareidolia? sure, it makes sense. Akira is his one believer, so it makes sense he'd be molded around Akira. Either for really needing that sacrifice, or just to pretend like he needs it so that Akira can act on his desires with justification.

But what about HOPE and Wires? HOPE seems to affect many people, so why would he need a sacrifice from Akira? Why wouldn't he just engaging in the act of transference suffice? Maybe the reason Akira is called child of makeshift gods is because these three are molded after him in the end? And aren't actual gods?
aramaug might have some answers for this, since I remember him talking about this event a while back. But I welcome others' perspectives as well.

posts.content_html_raw:
Moonflare said:
My god it took me forever to understand something so simple. Akira needs to take something that does not belong to him, because Sekai took something from him that didn't belong to her.
View attachment 4453074 View attachment 4453075 View attachment 4453076 View attachment 4453077 View attachment 4453078 View attachment 4453079
What this calls into question, however, is why would HOPE, Wires and Pareidolia all need something that it so specific to Akira's trauma. The reason to why Akira needs to rape his sacrifices is because he was raped by Sekai. Well, we know gods, in general, don't need that at all - they just need to be believed in and provide a function, it's a two way street.

So what is going on here? For Pareidolia? sure, it makes sense. Akira is his one believer, so it makes sense he'd be molded around Akira. Either for really needing that sacrifice, or just to pretend like he needs it so that Akira can act on his desires with justification.

But what about HOPE and Wires? HOPE seems to affect many people, so why would he need a sacrifice from Akira? Why wouldn't he just engaging in the act of transference suffice? Maybe the reason Akira is called child of makeshift gods is because these three are molded after him in the end? And aren't actual gods?
aramaug might have some answers for this, since I remember him talking about this event a while back. But I welcome others' perspectives as well.
Click to expand...
Funnily enough I can say I am not a smart man and a lot of what's going on in the game sometimes flies over my head or I miss something but that is actually one of the times I got what that meant right away, especially after finding out what had happened to him, I read that and it just clicked.

It's like 4am here and I'm still dealing with the cold and meds so correct me if I'm wrong but didn't Pareidolia admit that Akira is entertainment for them, that his suffering was their enjoyment, I would not be surprised if HOPE pushes it cause he knows it will lead to more despire and suffereing on Akira's side, thinking about it and agonizing over it and for Wires could be similar or maybe when Sekai went for ramen at the shop Akira was with her and if Tsuneyo's dad is Wires or connected to him and there is something special with Akira when it comes to the gods it make of taken notice of him and while not needing a sacrifice from it may just be waiting and watching (Again if I missed something correct me)

shmurfer said:
Dear You.
I'm writing this even though I have nowhere to send it. I'm sure I'll think it's
stupid in hindsight but if it helps me get over the fact that I can't see you
now. when I want to the most. it will be at least partially worth it. So... where
to begin.
i remember the first time you came over to- NO!
Do you remember the first time we- FUCK!!

I miss you so much.
Fuck writing letters

Dear You.
I'm stronger now. I only think about you for like 75% of every day. soooooo that's an improvement.

I had that dream again. The one where we all go to the city and you wind up proposing in front of my parents.
It seems so ridiculous to be having that NOW when it's been... I don't even know how long since we last talked.

Anyway. I hope you're eating well. I'm sure it must be hard even if you never particularly cared about your brother.
My parents miss you. Noriko misses you.
And of course...
Yeah.
Anyway. I'll be here if you need me.

- Niki

Dear You.
I fucking hate you. I hate you so so so so so so much.
It's unfucking fair that you just up and left when you KNOW that I would do
ANYTHING to even TRY to help you feel better. Do you have any idea how I feel not
being able to see you? Not having anyone to call before I go to bed? I can't even fucking open
Dragon Quest anymore because it was OUR save file and I don't want to KEEP
PLAYING WITHOUT YOU FUCK WHY ARE YOU NOT HERE.

PLEASE COME HOME

- The girl you left behind

Dear You.
My parents found out I've been writing letters to no one. They want me to talk to someone and
like...get help or whatever. I might. I don't know. It's a lot to take in.

How is Ami? I hope you two are getting along well. Noriko and I got into a fight over one of your old
t-shirts. I came home from school (I started going again) and saw that she stretched out the collar.
I slapped her in the face and she started crying but I never got in trouble for it. My parents probably
feel bad.

It still smells like you.

...

- Fuck

Dear You.
I've forgotten how many of these things I've written for you. but this might be the last.
I've been practicing my singing and dancing (You can make fun of me later) and I... think I was
scouted? I have an interview thing tomorrow and if it all goes well. I'll have to start focusing a lot
harder on...
Being away from you.

THIS IS YOUR LAST CHANCE
PLEASE CHECK THIS BOX IF YOU ARE COMING HOME
I'LL DROP IT ALL FOR YOU
                         I MEAN IT     I MISS YOU    GO FUC‎‎‎KYOURSELF
                     PLEASE        ☐           ☐‎
Niki Nakayama (In case you forgot)                           

VoidExile

Man those letters tickle my brain just right. And now I get the best event chain after Christmas 2 for that effort. Getting that 5th letter to format correctly was quite a bitch.

Jeez... that's so fucking depressing. I still don't think I know why he left but it's gotta be a really fucking good reason

posts.content_html_raw:
Ahh reached chapter 3 and Niki's first event What It Takes To Move Forward and wow I continue to be astonished at how much I resonate with the philosophical themes of this story on a daily level.




I'm constantly seeking out dark stories about broken people and tragedy partly because I empathize with the self-loathing part of myself that I struggled with for a LONG time.
But also feel like I'm trying to balance things out because things are...while they aren't perfect. I'm OKAY now...
but there definitely is always a part of me that feels scared, that if things get too good I will have to fall and I'm scared to find out what that would mean.
So I can't let myself be too HAPPY, I must balance it out with suffering even if it's through the lense of a piece of media.
And I'm eating this shit up.

Hearing these sad and traumatic tales really puts into perspective how worse it could be and prevents things from feeling for granted.
It makes all the good moments in these stories (and sometimes real life) feel almost euphoric.

Also it's kinda scary how certain aspects of Niki and Akira's relationship mirror my own first love. We gave each other our virginity when we were still together so that much is different, but she still meant a lot to me and of course it hurt when we fell apart. I'm sure many people had this type of first love, there's a reason why it's a trope but man the writing really nails the feeling of that relationship for me and makes me reminisce.

And of course the second massage is locked behind a deleted scene... or is it the second? I don't entirely remember but I think so.
Even hid one of those "finish me off and I will let you breath" blowjobs. Would have loved to see Miku's reaction to that.
The old type of ejaculation was better. Two rapid transition.
Futaba's blowjob scene is also locked behind a deleted scene. Well, it's a good thing you can still see them I guess.

The rest is all about care packages commentary.
Prisoner. I could have avoided hating Kirin by not "overindulging" on the grinding of lust points since the scene was optional. Dev describes that she was basically made to be a hatable character.
Stray cat. Confirmed my suspicion that the scarf likely stopped being sold for a long time. I never realized how much Maya is portrayed as a stray cat, always wondered what that bell was for, sort of a hint to make her more cat like. Apparently people were wondering if the dev worried people would grow to dislike Maya because it took so long for the first signs of weakness to appear, but for me it was the exact opposite, that moment of weakness enabled me to start feeling something for her.
Bluejay. 2 million words+, well damn. Did I predict Makoto was gonna leap of the building? I... don't think so. Even now I can't look at Makoto and say that this girl is depressed. It really is a hidden battle.

Delirium. When seeing Rin in that state, you ask yourself; "How can I help Rin?" I think the answer isn't some kind of prescription or telling her what she should or shouldn't do. The answer is to listen, be there for her and... accept her. Is this the what the dev wanted me to feel, or is this just who I am? An accepting person by nature?
I don't think I belong in this majority of players who only care about the characters on a surface level as the developer describes it. For me it was never about speed running the sex scenes, looking at the naked character and then leaving. Io became someone important the moment she showed a desire for affection. Tsuneyo won me over a little the moment she protected Molly's honor by revealing her inner anger. Already talked about Maya above.

This town has two halves. Arguably the event I remember the most. Oh I don't like that sound at all, I hate it. Annoying, creepy, stressing. I'm still a little lost as to why she kissed back. My interpretation of that is simply that she gave up and would hate herself for not playing along for her own sake. But that's not an decision you usually make at the moment but rather one you debate later on. Which brings in the question of hormones and whether that's something I can mentally grasp anymore on account of my age. I fear I may never truly understand why she played along, but perhaps I need a fitting analogy to help me understand, maybe something related to sweets?

Haven't progressed to "Too blind to see" yet.

Knowing that there is deeper meaning behind these events and everything that's said has deeper meaning and foreshadows future events, it really makes you think. This game is a masterpiece for all I know. I'm blind to art and this game has a lot of it, but there's more than enough that I do understand.

It hasn't been updated nor had other people explain it properly cause few people were smart enough to figure out what happened. The drm is hidden within a image file of the dorms, and gui.rpy has a call to the file presumably to check it. The patched gui.rpy just deletes the call. I'm not sure if gui.rpy is updated often, I warn people using it to repatch every update but it gui.rpy updated in any meaningful way surely something would break from a file that's several years out of date.

I don't know if it's a specific moment that calls the drm, some other people have mentioned it'd happen when the game queries to load care packages but I feel you would have already been bitten by that.

I wouldn't call your saves safe just cause you had a separate install. renpy makes a backup of saves based on project name in appdata, and propogates later save changes to the other location. If the drm got you on your care package install, and then you load your main game without purging the corrupt saves in theory they'd overwrite the good copy of your saves.

separate USB disk is hella overkill, there's only so much fuck selebus and whoever he outsourced the DRM to have to find your saves. I'd say a backup of your saves folder outside of your LIL folder is secure enough. As a result, some iterations made it far with Yumi, some iterations screwed up and made Yumi hate him even more, and some iterations completely ignored her so that their time was best used on fucking her available girls all day long. posts.content_html_raw:
The game clearly deliberately employs an interpretation of the Verfremdungseffekt. Its not a particularly complex thing to say, I would say everyone that has played the game will have noticed it even if they don't know there is some silly German word for what they have seen. Its probably one of the more clear things you can observe in the game with the amount of blatant 4th wall breaking and other moments such as; the "bread your nice minigame", having to reload a save to go back and get the Alexis event, the stupid reset puzzles, etc.

Speaking of the puzzles. Its kind of interesting to me that all games in general are basically permanently interacting with the idea of the "Verfremdungseffekt" to a far grater degree than most other mediums for telling a story. They require the player to actively ignore all the "video gamey" aspects of a game if they want to become "immersed" in it. If you are someone that plays a lot of games its already ingrained in you to ignore these things. If you ever get someone who has never played a game to play one a lot of the time they will hit various walls that you, as an experienced game player likely never even notice or thought would exist. Everything from controls and game mechanics that seem obvious to you, to things like using their inventory, saving and loading, respawning at the last checkpoint, even various UI elements that you might have an almost instinctual understanding of can create a disconnect for them. All that could be seen as a form of the "Verfremdungseffekt" that you have stared at for so long you are fully desensitized to. So with that in mind how would a game implement Brechtian ideas in a way that would actually be noticed by experienced game players, when we have trained our whole lives to ignore them. And I guess that's how you end up with the insufferable puzzles Sel put in this game and a lot of the other 4th wall stuff some people seem to hate.

Tangent aside, all I'm saying is that to call this game Brechtian is one of the more normal things you can say about it. Compared to some of the theories we manage to come up with. Its based in an established idea rather then our sometimes entirely insane readings of single paragraphs of text and singular images that look like a mad man drew them in MS Paint (he did).

Every other reset puzzle has been painfully obtuse. This one was straightforward with an obvious progression path.

posts.content_html_raw:
Regarding Yumi's tsundere nature. I get the impression that its more of a borderline thing than full on tsundere. Its not that she already likes him at the start of the game. Its that she wants to rely on him. (I'm pretty sure the game outright says this at some point) Not necessarily as a love interest at first, but just a person that wont give up on, or abandon/hurt her. Its a struggle between wanting to rely on him/trust him, but over and over seeing and learning things about him that scream to her that she should not. She learns these things and it upsets her, I don't think its entirely because she learns he might love someone else as you would expect from a jealous tsundere, but more that she learns he is a predator and keeps seeing things that confirm it to her. It's that repeated destruction of what in her mind she wanted him to be. Over and over again she reconciles something he did and he does something else. But in much the same way that she seems to still love her mum despite it all. She still wants to rely on Akira despite everything she learns about who he is. The struggle is the conflict between knowing what he is and that he will inevitably hurt her. The fear of that. But still caring about him despite everything and her having no idea what to do about it. Throw in the teenage hormones to further complicate it, as well as other things I did not mention. Then you end up with a character that I don't think is actually tsundere in the traditional sense.

Perhaps that all still fits under the tsundere umbrella and I'm just holding an umbrella that's been mangled by the wind without realising it. In which case this post is probably strange to read if I have managed to described tsundere while saying its not entirely tsundere. But I guess writing in depth characters makes it harder if not silly to encompass them in single archetypal categories anyway. So maybe it was pointless for me to type this out and post it in the first place?

The struggle is the conflict between knowing what he is and that he will inevitably hurt her. The fear of that. But still caring about him despite everything and her having no idea what to do about it. Throw in the teenage hormones to further complicate it, as well as other things I did not mention. Then you end up with a character that I don't think is actually tsundere in the traditional sense.
Perhaps that all still fits under the tsundere umbrella and I'm just holding an umbrella that's been mangled by the wind without realising it. In which case this post is probably strange to read if I have managed to described tsundere while saying its not entirely tsundere. But I guess writing in depth characters makes it harder if not silly to encompass them in single archetypal categories anyway. So maybe it was pointless for me to type this out and post it in the first place?

It's entirely their choice to ignore any ulterior motives you have. My stance on this is the same as the one I had with Yumi throwing away her mother's present. As long as there isn't something in there that can harm you, there is no point in throwing it away. It is, at the end of the day, a good action from someone else. It's entirely up to you whether you want to action to influence your opinion of them or not and whether you intend to make it up to them or not. So stop pretending that paying for their phone bills is in some roundabout way a bad action, and don't throw away presents from a person you hate unless you know they intend to harm you. Yeah, this was an... interesting start to the day.
No matter how much you tell yourself you are a bad person and there is nothing but ulterior motives in doing something good like paying for someone else's phone bill, at the end of the day, they see someone willing to lighten their financial burden for an extended period of time and that is without a doubt a good action regardless of why you do it. It's entirely their choice to ignore any ulterior motives you have. My stance on this is the same as the one I had with Yumi throwing away her mother's present. As long as there isn't something in there that can harm you, there is no point in throwing it away. It is, at the end of the day, a good action from someone else. It's entirely up to you whether you want to action to influence your opinion of them or not and whether you intend to make it up to them or not. So stop pretending that paying for their phone bills is in some roundabout way a bad action, and don't throw away presents from a person you hate unless you know they intend to harm you. The mc didn't ask for anything in return for paying those phone bills and Chika can pull the plug on that at any time if the mc gets demanding about it.

To stay on the Yumi topic, strangely, I never see any «love», at the beginning, on her part for Sensei.
For me, she's seeking for «attention», but a good attention, and not a physical one.

And she get it when Sensei «try» to help her getting a job. And, for me, that's the moment where a connection, and maybe some love, appear.
And when she saw Makoto with Sensei in the park, she wasn't jealous, but «envious». Because, at that scene in the park, what happen? Nothing. They aren't fucking. Nor kissing. They're barely just talking. (If my memory don't fuck me up again!)
All what Yumi ever wanted. Someone who can hear her out. Someone she can «trust». Someone who can be proud of her.

And, since Sensei isn't exactly what she need, but may be, she help him when he black-out. That's why she stay around when it happen. Not by «love», but with the hope that, if she support/help him, he might be able to support/help her.

Anyway, at least, that's how I see her.
Maybe I'm wrong.
Also, like all of the girls in this game, she have some insecurities. Maybe it's the age, but since I've never be a teenager myself, I don't know what's relevant or not.

posts.content_html_raw:
That quote from Maya in the early event someone posted earlier is really bothering me.

To me, you are nothing more than a worm. But to Ami and Ayane, you're the same man they've known since childhood. So it's no wonder they're as... forward about their feelings as they are. The rest are sue to follow suit. It's simply the way things work here.
Click to expand...
I've read these early Maya scenes around 5 to 6 times. That's not to brag; it's just kind of happened, and if anything it points to the fallibility of my memory that their contents remain only loosely in my mind at any given moment. This also includes reading the initial versions pre-rework (they totally suck BTW, good job improving your writing Selebus, almost nobody but me seems to acknowledge this so I'll take the time to emphasize the staggering difference in writing quality between the original version and the rework - might be worth writing a post dedicated to this later). Regardless, it is only now that I connect this line to the events of the most recent update.

'It is simply the way things work around here"... it's simply the way things work that all the girls end up lustful and aggressively pursuing Sensei? That REALLY sounds like a porn game, doesn't it? I admit, it makes me feel a bit foolish in retrospect to have described how difficult it was to be engaged with 0.46's developments, because I can easily imagine a Selebus figure going 'haha, it's only NOW you question the agency of the heroines and whether they are being unnaturally compelled to lust for Sensei?" or what have you. I mean, at various points I was aware of this line, and at various points I have identified seemingly unnatural behavior (indeed, even considering LiL's shockingly slow pacing, Chapter 1 has blisteringly fast developments with various heroines like Chika), so it's not like 0.46 was the first time I ever questioned it, but it did feel to cross a line. Maybe it didn't, though. Perhaps it was foolish to ever assume a time with unchallenged agency for every heroine.

I'm not necessarily going anywhere with this. The line is just bothering me. I feel a very strong sensation of being played for a fool, yet that surely is not the case. Like, I can't imagine Selebus would dedicate 4 years and counting to depicting stories of characters acting unnaturally in ways we should persistently question or disbelieve. I mean, it would be a very epic twist 3 years down the line, and people who have followed the story for 1 to 7 years would surely have their minds fucking blown if the dark route completely challenges their conception of the heroines and romances they have religiously followed up to that point, but it would feel totally staggering to do that I think. Like to commit so fucking hard for the bit. DDLC was fucking six hours long. Totono was like fucking 15. Nobody has committed 200-300 hours to this fucking bit. No way.

I wonder if Maya is from a different game.

Okay, guys, I tried to do something in Koikatsu Studio.
View attachment 4461184
View attachment 4461185
View attachment 4461186
90% of the work done here is on their skirts, because they just don't give a fuck about gravity. So, I have to fix them manually. The poses are pre-made Koikatsu poses.
What I really want to do is understand how to use lighting and shadows, because most KK h-games have the worst lighting I've ever seen, except for Imani's winter outfit, which is way worse.
Click to expand...
First off: I really like these renders. I can almost envision it as a 'Battle of Kumon-mi' type situation, where Yumi makes open threats but Nodoka's just messing around.

Secondly: you asked about lighting and shadows, sooo... mini tutorial time.

Here we have before us a KK render involving Kirin and Karin, all posed and basically ready to screenshot:



Looks serviceable, sure. But it could be better. It needs some extra lighting to really make it stand out.

Here's how:



Here's the menu you want to go to (in the top left corner). System > Scene Effects. The above screenshot is all set on Default settings, so this is what you will most likely see. Scroll down until you see Shadow Density.



Note that I have now adjusted my Shadow Density up to 0.85, and changed my Shadow Type to Slight, Smooth Shadows. The shadows should now be far more apparent.

Just because I used these settings, though, doesn't mean you have to follow it to the letter. You can mess around with these settings and see what you like best.

There's the shadows covered, now let's do the actual lighting.



Still in the Scene Effects menu, scroll up until you see Shade and Shade 2. Note the huge dropdown list in the above image. These are all your shaders, and they'll help immensely in making your renders look good. For reference, I'm using the Koikatsu Sunshine Better Repack, so if yours differs in any way, it's probably due to having certain modded shaders installed.

Anyway, I personally like the 'MOD_A' shader, so we'll use it for this example.



You might realize that the render already looks more vibrant than it did before. Shaders are good at that! Again, you can look through them and see what looks best to you.

This on its own could be sufficient enough for you, but I have just a couple more things to mention.



Just above Scene Effects, you'll see a menu labelled 'Char Lighting'. Click that, and the above settings should pop up for you. The Strength setting adjusts the overall brightness, while the two other sliders control the location of the central lighting. Mess around with them until the light is just where you want it to be. (Note: my lighting Strength is set at 1.24 in the above image, but the final renders I show are set to Strength 1.06)



Last thing. You may have noticed Sel uses lens flares a loooot in Chapter 4 in particular. And admittedly, I like the look of them too. They're helpful if you want a specific sort of light in the render itself. Using Lens Flare D as an example, it's usually good at simulating sunlight coming from the sky.

Click the magnifying glass on the left to search up the lens flares. (You can do this with pretty much any item or effect as well)



Move the lens flare into position and there! You have yourself an extra effect.

Admittedly I don't like the look of the above lens flare, as I don't think it fits, but I felt the need to mention them anyway.

With all that information in mind, lets compare the final renders, both with and without added lighting:


Keep practicing, man! It's a really fun and addicting hobby once you get used to it.

posts.content_html_raw:
Day 37 character count 16425.
Uta used to be a tomboy, even more so than Miku.

Molly probably won't be drinking for a while.

I don't think I've ever in my days of playing any game had any character refer to the mc as a coworker. More firsts.

These two are adorable together in a grownup way. Osako and Wakana.

Making Tsuneyo be the one to give these speeches while you see what characters in other places are up to is kind of weird.

Maki contemplating whether to stock up on chicken porn... wtf???

Sara to Haruka: "Well at least YOU didn't cry while there was a penis inside of you." OOOOF... You know I wonder how different all the dialogues would be if we friendzoned Haruka all the way back.

Dev using proper shadow character models now or whatever. They are all pink, not a blue one in sight.

Expecting an aunt or uncle to remember your birthday is kinda stupid tbh. I don't remember anyone else's birthday but my own. Maybe I'm the exception but I can't really judge anyone for not remembering, nor do I hold it against anyone for forgetting my own, less socialising and present opening pressure that way.

Wtf? Sara really gave the storage key to a stranger named Matthew of all things to get a birthday banner for Kaori instead of just getting it herself. At that point it's not even laziness, I don't know what that is.

Okay so Touka misplaced the mc's gift for Miku. "Fission mailed" indeed.

Is Yasu staring into a wall again or is that just the perspective? I swear, she's so adorably weird...

Welp, they didn't find the bear... Unbelievable. I blame this entirely on the mc tho. The bear probably doesn't weigh shit and nobody is gonna judge him for holding it, if anything it could have been beneficial for him. But nooo, he just had to give it to Touka.
Sike, I had a feeling he might have reclaimed it. His still an asshole for not telling her she did a good job tho. Seriously, this mc can't stop taking L's, which begs the question why his taking so many W's all the fucking time.
He did let her know tho, but at what cost?

Oh yeah, you can technically do that. Buy a bunch of raw inexpensive raw materials undercutting the spending limit and then make a product out of it. I think you can spend however much you want as long as the product itself has only used the materials whose value undercuts it. So you can get a perfect expensive present without going over the limit. I imagine there are plenty of things that cost like $20 that you can make into something that costs a couple $100. Heck, there might even be things you can make that costs thousand upon thousand of dollars because they are so hard to make and the success chance is low and you may need an entire workshop of volunteers to make it happen.

Wait, Nodoka is actually drunk?
Oh god, yep, she's drunk!
She's out of her fucking mind dude!
I would say I wish drunk Nodoka was a bit more lewd, but on account of the whole Molly incident, I don't think anything would really happen, even if Nodoka wanted it. It's too soon.

AYANE WTF ARE YOU HOLDING!? This crazy bitch has a fucking rocket launcher!
And wtf Touka? How expensive is that painting?
Did someone give Maya a watermelon? Dude, why is Maya so easy?
A 1million yen painting! That's 6.4k usd! You can buy two high end computers with that shit! Or a fucking car! No wonder Makoto is crying, that's probably a shit ton of money for someone in Japan.
Wow, I guessed right. $20. I think I faintly remember that being last years budget.
I wonder what that painting is ACTUALLY worth on a raw material scale?

Oof, awkward indeed. I'm telling you, this mc is a huge wreck. How broken do you have to be to not at least try to think up a fitting present for someone?

Miku reaction to the bear can't be that she hates it and it can't be that she loves it because it's like there is nothing more hiding behind it and I think it has something to do with her childhood.
Wait, is it bad because she loves it so much that she will break her own promise to let Makoto have him!? So she both loves and hates it.
Hold on, is it because all the gifts she receives are tomboyish in nature and she always desire to be seen as a girl, so getting a girly gift like this means that much to her?

"There is something buried underneath your feet"'s little known cousin "And something above as well."

Wtf? That is so cryptic. A bunch of / followed by:
"
EVENT COMPLETE
ATTEMPTING TO DOWNLOAD CARE PACKAGE
DOWNLOAD SUCCESSFUL
PLEASE CONTINUE WALKING. YOU ARE VERY GOOD AT IT.
"
Like what does that even mean!?

Wonder if what's in the box is something Maya doesn't want the mc to see?
I have look at this sky so many god damn times now that it's getting kinda upsetting.

Oh I see. It's the letters that flashed by during Niki's invite over, but they aren't transitioning this time. Guessing Noriko is hurt by them because it's her sister spewing out her feelings or whatever. Not sure how that would make him dislike Noriko tho, unless she's worried he will fall for Niki and abandon her.

Why did I not put any thought into this until now? Both Noriko and Kirin are younger sisters who are the underdog at everything and they both live together. Both main girls, both big sisters are side girls.

Did his mind explode or what? I mean it was about the past, about Niki and him, but does Niki count or does it have to be Noriko?

The care package thing again... Does it have anything what so ever to do with the dlc's?

Oh, that makes a little more sense. The care packages tend to show the characters with a different body proportion. Mc looked kinda lame back then huh? Not that there was much of an improvement. I mean right now he kinda looks like his been hurt a lot unlike back then. Weird how the game captured that effect perfectly.

Niki used his real name and it got redacted. Past mc sees current mc.

Did Noriko flip a switch or is this kind of creepy?

I bet Niki didn't want him to see those.
And I imagine that Maya didn't either, but at least his head didn't explode, contrary to the popping sound. Still wonder what that survey was for tho.
I guess that was the first actual confirming memory that he used to know Niki.
And coincidentally, Maya messaged him...
Yuuup, she knows about the letters.

Well, it turns out she became an idol to spread the message of her existence. Also I feel like things got difficult now with her pouring her heart out.

Uh oh, here comes Maya!
Hmm? Just gonna silently wait? What does that mean...?
And she ran away. Only time will tell what that kiss made her think.

Why is he going back to the party when Maya was suppose to be waiting at the rooftop? Is he stupid?

That voice fits Yasu really well. About as frail and mild and broken as she appears.
It's a scene like this that makes me realize how much content the dev could setup that makes her seem like she's enduring immeasurable pain to keep the world from breaking or something. You get what I mean? That slow singing, alone in a room, the way she dresses and everything else about her. Maybe she's not creepy, she's just misunderstood and acts the way she does to cope or something? I dunno. I just imagine like a scene where she has to face her demons and can't stop crying screaming and the mc just stands there in shock not knowing what to do. As if in that moment, she needs more comforting than any other character ever has. What a thought provoking scene this is. Maybe I'm getting ahead of myself.

If there is a firework show going on right now and Maya is on the roof... Hmmm...

Like for all I know, Yasu is just as normal as anyone else. Pain, suffering, emotions, confidence issues. She just has to show them in this unique way.

Miku couldn't keep it in after all...

Yep, there we go. Nodoka got too drunk.

So many people suffering this event...
Rin and Otoha's relationship will never work out, as wonderful as it is the problem is Otoha's parents would never approve of it and Otoha can't commit to the relationship beyond making Rin feel loved but she backs out and chooses her parents when that security is threatened. This will never be a viable relationship unless she can get her parents to approve and even then it feels like it would only be a matter of time before it all comes crashing down.
Welp... I should have known their relationship would reach this unstable point the moment we found out her parents were strict, which was before she had even arrived at the school to begin with.

I'm starting to think Tsukasa secretly belongs in the same tier as Kirin.

Chika feels like she have been drunk in that room before but I don't recall very well. The only incident I can recall about her being drunk is when Touka and her were doing a strip tease.

WHYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY! He fucking forgot the meeting with Maya! That idiot! God fucking damnit how do you forget something like that!?
Welp. Apparently Yasu can tell Maya is pacing around on the top floor waiting for him.

Oh would you look at that. The reset event includes the number of stairs. Totally not suspicious at all.

And of course he missed the fire works.

No I can't say I recall seeing a girl from a game or series holding her hand to the sky the moment the mc or someone shows up.

Wonder if we will ever find out just how much time Maya has really spent going through these cycles.

He didn't stand Maya up. That's not how that works. He already had a plan and told her he will show up after that.

That slow transition of her facial expression when he said he remembered something... I can't tell if it's just surprise or fear and surprise, or concern?

Maya must HATE that. Not being able to tell him about the past without him short circuiting but Noriko and Niki can tell him just fine.

...isn't that the mystery girl sitting up there? I almost missed her...

Damn, he forced a blush out of her by pointing out she really is in love with him.
And another blush when he said his always liked seeing her in the shrine maiden outfit... The day when Maya stops holding back and the world doesn't try to destroy him in the process will be a good day.

Molly gave him a shirt... Well alright then. I bet she asked Ami for his size or something. It's very... blue.

Christmas event over.

Otoha doesn't look happy and the ominous "pull the plug" event name doesn't help.
She makes it sound like the Christmas party was long ago but it was yesterday. Makes me wonder if the dev intended for people to be very confused about where to go and what to do until some weeks have past and they finally figure it out. Like it's literally the morning after the night the party was happening and she was with her parents at that time. So she wouldn't have had many hours talking to anyone else at that point.

Rin is really that mad? To think that someone who falls so easily can afford to be mad.
Six rocks and a lesbian. Now that sounds like an interesting tv series if it existed.

Who said him dating the students is a good idea? He does that, Otoha don't and between the two, Otoha seems more sane (for now).

Otoha and Niki look like they are the same age. Far from the truth tho.
Mc really be taking a phone call in the middle of Otoha's vocal class.
"Two octave pitch glide tactic" That sounds ridiculous, like a fucking music shooter or action game or something.
That's so much pressure... Imagine having to treat your entire audience like they are your girlfriend!
Guess Otoha didn't expect a hug from behind by Niki.
Niki is ruthless in vocal cord teaching.

I can already tell Nodoka will grow up to be a mad scientist. She's already there technically.

There is surprisingly little food out there that's grey as far as I can tell. But they do exist.

She's like an inch away from his face right now.

His finally getting a little closer to Otoha.

Gotta love how the game is foreshadowing Otoha's manic episode so hard.

It's a double date, but one of the relationships ended a long time ago and the other is treading dangerous waters.

Yep, it's fucking over. Rin and Otoha's relationship is doomed. She got over the parent thing, Rin let the threat from her parents to cut off the money slip, Niki offered to pay for it, Otoha went silent and Rin got hurt by it.
Rin is just being way too pushy with this in general. She shouldn't have to see someone's parents, I don't know why I've been taking Rin's side on this the entire time in text or whatever I've been doing but I really don't think anyone should let a relationship hang by a main thread like this and let meeting parents be the deciding factor if the relationship works or not. I don't understand the obsession and whatever media I've played seem to portray it as a huge fucking deal.

Well, it appears the ship that was sailing on dangerous oceans appear to have got a leak.

So Otoha IS embarrassed to be dating a girl.

Honestly it's fucking unreasonable for parents to expect their daughter to be dating a man when most of the men are in fucking space of all places. At that point you aren't mad she's dating a girl, you are mad she's dating AT ALL. Because if you weren't you are either A. trying to doom her into a bad relationship with a man taking his chances on multiple girls because his now more desirable, or B. you want her to fucking suffer by not dating. And knowing what I've heard about strict Japanese parents, they don't want their children to date until after they are adults or even after they are done with collage through methods of threatening to kick them out of the house which they legally can due to the age of the child.

Is that how that happens? They have a major near breakup worthy argument and then they go back to making out? Teenage behavior probably. Hormones and such.

And that was Otoha's chain. Will they be able to keep this crumbling relationship going?
5 more characters, couple chain events and a couple more main events before the reset. I'm skeptical if I can get this done today.

He was consciously aware his inner monologue tends to say exactly what's about to happen, he even thought of the word intervention and lo and behold, that's exactly what it is and it even says it on the sign thingy.

I have expected him to just close the door and again.

Ahh yes, "relationship with little sensei". Those are wise words, Miku.

Well, the painting ended up not going to Makoto but going to her mother which in turn probably got sold. Wonder how she reacted to hearing about a 1mil yen painting tho?

Dude, why the fuck would he feel inclined to bring up Miku's parents in front of her!? Why does he always do this shit!? You think just because you got close to someone that you can just bring up traumatic events that have no use to either of you because you are closer or some bullshit!? What kind of shitty writing is this? Why the fuck did the dev make him do that?
It's one thing to know about someones traumatic past, it's another to bring it up. You are intending to sate your curiosity. If it's already been sated, there is no reason to bring your knowledge to their attention unless they are willing to brave it out and even if they do, you can just pretend you didn't know.

Yasu with a different hairstyle would be nice yeah.
I was going to go back and check what hair she had during that dorm war thing but I clicked on the wars end thing and apparently you can get it so that both team wins and there is no bonus points. I was trying to do that some time ago but the bonus points are uneven so...
Well I guess this is exclusive to the red path.
Ahh yes, that was the hair style. Imagine Yasu with straight hair tho. That would be kinda weird.
Wait, so is it actually impossible to reply the first floor's sleepover after that?

Dev using proper shadow character models now or whatever. They are all pink, not a blue one in sight.
Expecting an aunt or uncle to remember your birthday is kinda stupid tbh. I don't remember anyone else's birthday but my own. Maybe I'm the exception but I can't really judge anyone for not remembering, nor do I hold it against anyone for forgetting my own, less socialising and present opening pressure that way.
Wtf? Sara really gave the storage key to a stranger named Matthew of all things to get a birthday banner for Kaori instead of just getting it herself. At that point it's not even laziness, I don't know what that is.
Okay so Touka misplaced the mc's gift for Miku. "Fission mailed" indeed.
Is Yasu staring into a wall again or is that just the perspective? I swear, she's so adorably weird...
Welp, they didn't find the bear... Unbelievable. I blame this entirely on the mc tho. The bear probably doesn't weigh shit and nobody is gonna judge him for holding it, if anything it could have been beneficial for him. But nooo, he just had to give it to Touka.
Sike, I had a feeling he might have reclaimed it. His still an asshole for not telling her she did a good job tho. Seriously, this mc can't stop taking L's, which begs the question why his taking so many W's all the fucking time.
He did let her know tho, but at what cost?
Oh yeah, you can technically do that. Buy a bunch of raw inexpensive raw materials undercutting the spending limit and then make a product out of it. I think you can spend however much you want as long as the product itself has only used the materials whose value undercuts it. So you can get a perfect expensive present without going over the limit. I imagine there are plenty of things that cost like $20 that you can make into something that costs a couple $100. Heck, there might even be things you can make that costs thousand upon thousand of dollars because they are so hard to make and the success chance is low and you may need an entire workshop of volunteers to make it happen.
Wait, Nodoka is actually drunk?
Oh god, yep, she's drunk!
She's out of her fucking mind dude!
I would say I wish drunk Nodoka was a bit more lewd, but on account of the whole Molly incident, I don't think anything would really happen, even if Nodoka wanted it. It's too soon.
AYANE WTF ARE YOU HOLDING!? This crazy bitch has a fucking rocket launcher!
And wtf Touka? How expensive is that painting?
Did someone give Maya a watermelon? Dude, why is Maya so easy?
A 1million yen painting! That's 6.4k usd! You can buy two high end computers with that shit! Or a fucking car! No wonder Makoto is crying, that's probably a shit ton of money for someone in Japan.
Wow, I guessed right. $20. I think I faintly remember that being last years budget.
I wonder what that painting is ACTUALLY worth on a raw material scale?
Oof, awkward indeed. I'm telling you, this mc is a huge wreck. How broken do you have to be to not at least try to think up a fitting present for someone?
Miku reaction to the bear can't be that she hates it and it can't be that she loves it because it's like there is nothing more hiding behind it and I think it has something to do with her childhood.
Wait, is it bad because she loves it so much that she will break her own promise to let Makoto have him!? So she both loves and hates it.
Hold on, is it because all the gifts she receives are tomboyish in nature and she always desire to be seen as a girl, so getting a girly gift like this means that much to her?
"There is something buried underneath your feet"'s little known cousin "And something above as well."
Wtf? That is so cryptic. A bunch of / followed by:
"
EVENT COMPLETE
ATTEMPTING TO DOWNLOAD CARE PACKAGE
DOWNLOAD SUCCESSFUL
PLEASE CONTINUE WALKING. YOU ARE VERY GOOD AT IT.
"
Like what does that even mean!?
Wonder if what's in the box is something Maya doesn't want the mc to see?
I have look at this sky so many god damn times now that it's getting kinda upsetting.
Oh I see. It's the letters that flashed by during Niki's invite over, but they aren't transitioning this time. Guessing Noriko is hurt by them because it's her sister spewing out her feelings or whatever. Not sure how that would make him dislike Noriko tho, unless she's worried he will fall for Niki and abandon her.
Why did I not put any thought into this until now? Both Noriko and Kirin are younger sisters who are the underdog at everything and they both live together. Both main girls, both big sisters are side girls.
Did his mind explode or what? I mean it was about the past, about Niki and him, but does Niki count or does it have to be Noriko?
The care package thing again... Does it have anything what so ever to do with the dlc's?
Oh, that makes a little more sense. The care packages tend to show the characters with a different body proportion. Mc looked kinda lame back then huh? Not that there was much of an improvement. I mean right now he kinda looks like his been hurt a lot unlike back then. Weird how the game captured that effect perfectly.
Niki used his real name and it got redacted. Past mc sees current mc.
Did Noriko flip a switch or is this kind of creepy?
I bet Niki didn't want him to see those.
And I imagine that Maya didn't either, but at least his head didn't explode, contrary to the popping sound. Still wonder what that survey was for tho.
I guess that was the first actual confirming memory that he used to know Niki.

Yuuup, she knows about the letters.
