Meanwhile Touka has black her which I guess is cut in a certain way to show some grace or something and she is less welcoming but not exactly hostile. She follows more traditional values and such and has arguably the best body, both based on the lore I know and visually so. So it's like her physical genes are suppose to match her social status and it would be strange if her hair wasn't black to show that she's a true Japanese traditionalist or something. I'm not making 100% sense of these "opposites" but I can sort of see it. Just like how Niki's hair is pink and she's an adult, which is probably the preferred solo idol color, at least in anime. But I'm basing that off nothing. Point is, all 3 are relatively rich and paints a very stereotypical vibe of sorts.
He is still taking out sex toys out of their boxes to mess with Makoto. Why does Makoto like him again?
Poor Molly! Getting cleaning liquid in her eyes because the mc decided to aim for her face. If you remove the "cleaning liquid" part of that comment, it would have a very different implication.
Nodoka going around groping everyone in the showers huh. She can probably get away with that perfectly fine given her intelligence.
Nodoka "knows" about Makoto's relationship with him. Not too surprising.
So close. Maybe next time.
Nodoka is like a better version of Makoto now that I think about it.
There are 5 Nodoka scenes yet to be unlocked. Wonder if this will continue with Sensei fucking all her friends while she watches or if she will stop being stubborn and try to get some of her own experiences to write about.
Yumi behind teaser, hmm...
Oh, OH! Okay! What a sight!
HAHAHAHAHAHA!!! Nodoka stole Yumi's clothes! I don't know what to say here, that's fucking hilarious! Serves her right for being so rude, huh? The delinquint part time bully gets bullied!
Holy fuck, Nodoka is devilish! I love it! Is she gonna try to traumatize Yumi by letting the mc see her in that condition?
I feel so bad for what's about to happen but I feel less bad about who it is.
Oh no! Okay, maybe I DO feel quite bad after all! This is Nodoka putting oil on the fire! Yumi is even crying having no idea what to do.
What I don't get is why she hasn't put on a towel or something (Nodoka took those as well). Those should be around and should cover everything, but I wonder if she has a new phone to call Chika with and if she could move around mostly undetected.
But holy shit, that body of hers! Is it better or worse than Touka's? I had to look it up in koikatsu. Apparently the only difference appears to be that Touka's breasts are just a tiny bit larger. Hmm...
Well, Nodoka and Kirin now have something else in common. The only difference is that Kirin punishes good people while Nodoka punishes bad.
Yumi's got a point. The mc is not a victim, SHE is. She had to deal with her clothes being stolen, crying and distressed and being looked at by someone who forced himself on her in the past. He on the other hand were deceived and got to look at Yumi naked which, lets be honest, is pretty fucking sweet given how attractive she is.
Nodoka deserves detension for tihs, and not the good kind. Is the mc gonna be responsible enough to do that on Yumi's behalf?
Even the mc acknolaged her beauty.
Nodoka that bitch! Now she's gone too far!
Why... I don't fucking understand... Why do the sex positive girls always have to go too far? If I was the mc in this situation I would have snatched her phone and threatened to smash it into a million pieces, then put her in detention. But I'm not the mc and this mc doesn't care enough to do something like that.
Threatening with blackmail now, unlike what she did with Makoto.
Of course it's revenge for Yumi bullying Futaba. And after Yumi went ahead and apologized to Futaba she STILL went through with this despicable plan.
Again, WHY, why do BOTH the characters who talks about sex so much have to resort to traumatizing others? FUCK DUDE! Of course it can't be that easy! One day ago Nodoka was heading to the top of the list and then she went and did something this evil knowing the mc won't do shit about it. She is willing to ruin Yumi's ONLY friendship after Yumi already went through hell and back just to get revenge! If the mc was smart here, he could threaten Nodoka with telling Futaba what Nodoka did. But of course, Futaba would be asking what he was doing with Yumi there and it all would go back to him trying to meet and fuck Nodoka. Fuck dude, I didn't expect Nodoka to use her smarts for something like this!
...I had a thought just now. If Nodoka wants something in return, hinted at wanting to see all her "friends" get fucked by the mc, then what's stopping her from making Yumi do something sexual with the mc right now?
Nodoka is the opposite of the mc... Mc hates seeing girls cry, Nodoka apparently loves it. She just had to be evil underneath all that sexuality...
Yep, there it is. She's asking Yumi to do something sexual.
What? So either Yumi pleasures herself in front of them to completion, or Nodoka pleasures the mc in front of Yumi? If Yumi chooses to pleasure herself here instead of letting Nodoka pleasure the mc, it means underneath that appearance of Yumi's, she likes the mc too much to let that happen.
That fucking smug look of Nodoka's... what's the answer?
I knew it! Is Nodoka really smart enough to think Yumi likes the mc?
I KNEW she was gonna use that excuse! She went for the masturbation option and then proceeded to say she is only doing it for Chika's sake but that's not true!
And I just remembered, both Nodoka and Kirin went for the trauma route because they wanted revenge for something that happened a while ago. In Kirin's case it was a competition she couldn't win and in Nodoka's case it's on her friend's behalf. God, I wish I knew how Futaba would react knowing what Nodoka did.
Welp. That's a scene right there.
Why did I not think of that? Could Yumi's words have caused Futaba to force herself to puke to go down in weight?
Man, this is painful... If you were presented with opportunities to hurt someone in order for them to grow to be a better person, you have to set aside your morals and look at it objectively. Nodoka is doing this out of revenge and she is smart enough to pull it off. I just wish one of the characters I liked wouldn't go to this length. I don't know how it would have been done, but if it was Kirin doing this to Yumi... I dunno, I guess I would have felt better knowing I don't have to see what Nodoka is truly capable of doing.
Nodoka is giving me a cruel lesson with this speech and I don't like it... Feel utterly helpless as a reader too. The game really is a test. Honestly at this point, I wouldn't be surprised if the game was preparing me for an inevitable rape ntr scene... I guess if I can handle that and I finish the game some 6 years laters, barely reacting to that content, it will just make me wonder, did the game break me? Or did it strengthen me?
Oh that would have been great! What y'all think? Would Yumi have chosen to suck him off instead of letting Nodoka do it if Yumi couldn't finish?
He was way too quick to let Nodoka come up for air there. Why does she have to be the only one who doesn't suffer, huh? WHY? Let her fucking choke on the thing, pass out! It's not like she stated in the rule that she has to be conscious while he has her finish him off!
Ruined orgasm...
Gogo Yumi! Destroy her fucking phone! Apparently Nodoka isn't smart enough to know what would happen right after the last picture was deleted.
In other news, Yumi's new outfit. I can't believe THIS is the debut of it.
Glad the mc is smart enough to realize his inaction really hurt Yumi. Never in a million years would I have expected this little "present" of Nodoka's to go this far... The dev could have chosen to end it there with him calling Chika and explaining Nodoka's prank, but that would have been far too happy for the kind of game I'm playing...
I imagine for another few chapters, I will keep wishing this game had a different mc. His far too cold. I thought chapter 3 was gonna change that, but chapter 3 has only just started.
At the end of the day, Yumi needs to learn to get along with people and Nodoka was the one who forced that change through trauma. I just wish the mc would have handled this situation better but I guess because he didn't, Yumi never got the justification and relief she needed. Meanwhile, Ayane never hurt a fly, yet she had to suffer for it. Kirin is objectively a worse person than Nodoka.
It speaks volume for how heartless the mc is when he says he doesn't know how he feels about Nodoka after all of this and Nodoka then take that to mean that his opinion of her hasn't changed. If you asked me that question? My opinion of her have changed quite drastically for the worse, but putting her in the same category as Kirin would not right. Kirin is a special kind of evil. Nodoka took revenge for herself because her friend who didn't want to take revenge had been bullied by Yumi for that long. Meanwhile, Kirin took revenge because she got second place in a competition BOO FUCKING HOO, big difference, not even comparable. That any of that make Nodoka some fucking hero? Not even close. But I'm sure that overtime she did everyone a favor and I will look back on this moment and backtrack on my answer.
The mc isn't doing a good enough job grinding affection with Yumi but I really hope this doesn't set them back too much.
Oh and also, that was TWO Nodoka scenes. Because apparently touching a friend's body and showing it off is enough to justify a scene. Meanwhile every other scene includes someone cumming. I don't agree with this, that's fucking bullshit.
Can someone remind me what my reaction was to seeing that Touka only has one scene in the game right now because I want to do that again but with Yumi, FUCK MY LIFE! One fucking scene with Yumi, that's it? I feel that creeping urge to smash something right now. Oh and I remembered now. AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA! Yeah, it went something like that.
Two of the most attractive characters with nearly identical bodies, both only having 1 scene. Does the dev hate us? I think the dev hates us.
I feel mentally exhausted. I want to go to bed, but it's a little too early and I don't know if I could sleep anyway. I would like to say it's not nearly as bad as I make it sound but I don't know what the game could pull that would put me in that bad of a move anyway.
From Yasu in the morning to misc stuff to a shit ton of Yumi and Nodoka stuff to back to a... frowning Yasu? That's new. Has she ever frowned before without tears or crazy eyes? This looks like a genuine frown of sadness, but not the kind of crying sadness.
Now I got thoughts I need to push into the back of my mind... I got so discouraged by the realization that Yumi doesn't have more scenes and nor does Touka that I just kinda felt... what if I stop playing here? Of course I'm not going to, but it's those kinds of thoughts that make me subconsciously zone out of boredom while playing, knowing there is very little to look forward to. Would it be entitled for me to say that the dev should have rushed in some new Touka or Yumi scenes in chapter 3 or early chapter 4 just to keep me motivated?
Yasu felt, Yumi spotted Nodoka, what is she about to do...?
Yuuuuuuup... Nodoka should have known better than to push Yumi this far. I genuinely hope Yumi doesn't get punished for this. The mc is the only one who knows the reason, but I doubt he has the balls to defend Yumi. If anything, he might be more likely to defend Nodoka.
Well, as it turns out, Yumi is NOT all talk after all. Which is surprisingly relieving.
Makoto: "I'm so disappointed in you, Yumi... it really seemed like you were getting better..." That triggered me so badly, I had the instant urge to smash my table just then.
Mc, you are greatly misunderstanding what you COULD have done! Fucking tell them that Nodoka did something to traumatize Yumi that she didn't deserve and say it's confidential! That's all you had to fucking done you absolute piece of shit! Fucking coward! I knew this piece of shit wasn't gonna do anything! Which is still better than actually helping Nodoka in this situation I feel, and I don't have to explain why.
GOD FUCKING DAMNIT MC! TALK! TAAAAALK!
I can't believe I haven't entertained the idea of wanting to punch this mc until now, fuck this mc FUCK HIM, stupid piece of shit!
Nodoka could have at least given the cryptic "I deserved that for what I did". But no, she feels the need to perv instead.
What's gonna happen to Makoto? Yasu? Hello?
Dafuq? What is Maki doing here and why does she look so... angry?
It's like all hell has broken loose... I still have absolutely no clue why Maki is that mad and why Makoto was called to the office. So many chain reactions these past 2 events...
So much anticipation...
I knew it... I had only one thing in my mind that would cause this. She was called to the office to be told that her father had past away... Maki was in that state fearing how Makoto would do when she found out.
I had another look at the main girls and I'm pretty sure Makoto is the only one with a dad in space who had to go to space while he was still present in her life. Given how much Makoto misses her dad... well. This is an emotional rollercoaster today.
Let me guess. The messenger that let them know Makoto's dad is dead also let Haruka know that her husband is dead?
Yep, phone call has only just started and it seems to just confirm my suspicion.
??? Never mind then.
Uhh, those eyes are scary as fuck.
Wait, don't tell me, he is back and found out about the relationship and left her?
Or maybe he didn't come back but she was told that his alive and fine so she can't hide behind the blanket that maybe he actually is dead and she's not a cheater.
I'm starting to see the pattern here. Crying, scared and concerned, angry, laughing. I've done all those things in the past couple hours.
Yuuup, there it is. Her husband is alive.
Honestly, waiting 2 months to hear about someone IN SPACE who died doesn't seem that weird considering that space is huge and they never said where in space they are. I imagine it can't be easy to hold phone calls with Earth from space and I imagine if they are gonna do that, they are probably gonna go through a long list all at once when the signal is strongest.
Also, time works differently in space than on Earth.
And yeah, an automated phone call... I think those might be easier to make from space on account of the delay.
Wait, how do Rin know Haruka and Sensei are going at it? I don't remember how she figured that out, or if it just happened.
I really don't care about Haruka... I really don't. I just get demotivated when her events pop up. And for this to happen NOW of all times after the whole Yumi and Nodoka situation.
Oh, greeeeeeat... And now they throw in a new character into the mix.
Pretty sure her daughter doesn't want her to visit because of her tattoos and Japan... they don't mix very well.
Maki is great at holding back, huh. Guess she's letting it all out now. She's fucking losing it...
Wow, dude. Slapping Haruka like that. Uncalled for.
Stranger in their house?
Why did I not notice that? Makoto eyes were the same as his own. They became that way after the jump too. Is it just depression or something else? A deeper understanding of the world maybe? Or get this, what if Makoto DID die and was respawned as someone else just like what happened to him?
Hmm, rape, blackmail and... fem dom? Think that's what this is.
Choking too.
I feel like this is gonna be how Maki discovers their relationship. If she walks in like I expect that is.
Oh... well that's just fantastic. Spent all that time going through chain events just for the game to finally throw me into freeplay with no Yumi or Nodoka in sight. Futaba is there tho but she's locked behind a Maki event which is locked behind a Makoto event which is locked behind Friday and right now it's Monday. Also there's an Io event but that one is also locked behind the Maki event and a Karin event and she has absolutely nothing to do with any of this. My point is... I'm exhausted and I wish the game wouldn't delay things like this when I had a fit of rage at the mc's incompetence.
What a fucked up day.
What a horrible fucked up day...

spoilers.html:
I just read "lo and behold" and "Io" the character.

Two random things the mc has done that makes no sense. He went on that date with Rin that ended with a kiss and now it's like it never happened. All that buildup for nothing. The second being the fact his willing to pay for Chika, Chinami and Yumi's phone bills which is weird as I doubt he is getting much out of it.

Okay, so Yumi got indefinitely suspended. Doesn't that mean she could be suspended anywhere from a week to until the end of her life? I'm telling you, this is bullshit. The mc's cowardly move of not speaking up is what did this. I feel like Nodoka should have been suspended as well, but no one knows what happened and the mc doesn't speak up so of course Nodoka is seen as the victim here.

Whole fucking class is reacting to Makoto's return... I guess she's left an impression on everyone huh.
Oh, OH she's basically telling everyone what happened without right out saying it.

Welp, I have no idea what this will mean for Makoto's future. Her story could take any number of turns now.

Ami? Out of all the people to hug Makoto... Oh, OHHHH, it's because Ami can relate!
Well that explains why Ami went silent while Maya was talking to her... I didn't even think about this. Ami is the one who hates Makoto but this is a complete 180.
Oh, I see what's going on! Ami lived through this and now she's happy! Sure, she still goes through those painful memories again but she pulled through and knows Makoto can too!

And Miku too but I think her situation is different in a roundabout way. Honestly, like I said before, Ami knows the pain better than anyone.

Wait, is that thing the girls are wearing in archery practice suppose to be like a... boob shield?

Almost thought I wouldn't get to see that Makoto hairstyle anymore for a sec, or at least this early. By "dropping off Makoto for a therapy session" is that just Maki's way of saying, "I'm bringing Makoto with my to your house."?
Wtf? HAHAHA! Okay, well that was unexpected. I guess the therapist in question is Ami. Well, I suppose there is no better therapist than someone who have already went for the shit you are now going through.
What an unlikely "friendship".

I feel like his referring to Maya. Maya is the one person he doesn't want to lose, both because he almost did and because of how everything would get fucked over if Maya isn't there to reset everything.

"So you HAVEN'T gone out of your way to provoke her behind Futaba's back and seek vengeance on her behalf?"
Nodoka speaks to eloquently that I can't tell what is and isn't a lie. I don't know what reservation the mc has to blurt out what Nodoka did, or imply it. There is no world where taking revenge by inflicting trauma should be okay and I would rather prioritize bumping Nodoka down a peg than prioritize what Yumi wants to remain a secret. I would have easily chosen the safe choice and mention that Yumi was the victim of the traumatic experience Nodoka forced on and only reveal that the trauma in question was sa if pressured enough.

I think we hate Kirin and Nodoka because they are doing the evil acts so that the mc can have a better experience, and WE DO NOT root for the mc right now. Or at the very least I hope you don't. We can root for him to get better, but not support his current misdeeds. Being an accomplice to the crimes of those two should not be something the mc should want, yet he clings to it like a confused animal having it's parents killer giving it food for adoption. Obviously an excessive metaphor but the concept is right.

I once again question what my true intent of continuing to play through this story is. At the rate things are going, I don't expect the mc to start properly being nice until like chapter 5 or 6, even then it feels a bit too generous. This world may have been built for him but it sure as hell weren't built for us. I feel like a victim. Send help.

The mc keeps sneaking in these metaphors that he does not approve of Nodoka's behavior. If only those metaphors weren't just in his head and vibrating the air as well.

A kind narcissist who traumatizes bullies to avenge a friend who doesn't want to be avenged. Right.

And there we have a Futaba blushing furiously having almost said she loves the mc.

Must be a really suspicious or good or suspicious and good book if Futaba tries to hide behind a folder.
Yeah, I think that's a suspicious and good book.

It doesn't sit right with me to be cozying up to a Futaba reading smug in the library while there is probably a very upset and embarrassed Yumi hiding away somewhere that I want a status report on.

Io: "I just have an unquenchable desire to cuddle-" omg she's perfect. So anyway...
Uhh, so I guess Kirin and Io are never going to be friends. Didn't think back when that she felt so strongly against it.

No I think that makes perfect sense. If you can make a struggling person struggle less or even not struggle at all and give them a better life, of course you are gonna feel better about yourself. Unless you are some kind of sadist or something. But if you care about a person, their success will be your success in a way.

He stepped on her caterpillar, didn't he... Either that or poop.

God, I hate the words "tonsil hockey"! Whoever came up with that phrase and popularized it did an unforgivable sin I tell ya!

My god, what a cute reaction. I can't tell if Uta reacted that way because the position they are standing in or if it's the prospect that his willing to practice with her if they are this intimate.

That's not convincing at all...
I've never seen worse acting in text format before.

Wonder if when I find out what the real reason behind her behavior is if I will be surprised or not.
Both index fingers touching, an awkward wide smile, looking of to the distance, somewhat strained eyebrows, very red face... Is it even possible to make it more obvious that she's nervous than this?

Uh oh, she found the caterpillar he stepped on... poor thing. F to the caterpillar.

I imagine Sara is just joking at doesn't actually think Io and Yuki would be okay with being seen naked with the mc.

What a rude customer. Rin just wanted to shout goodbye to someone important to her and you have the audacity to get pissed of? No wonder you are at a cafe in the morning.
Going to the streets right now gives you a message that says that you should try to see Yumi right now. And the dorm visit option doesn't exist. Nor can you call her. Damn you Nodoka... Welp, I hope when she does come back, she will come back in full force.
Fully exposed arms and the boob window esc opening does make the maid outfit more risqué in a way.
Wait, Uta doesn't realize she's blushing? That's interesting. I think her body wants more than her consciousness is aware of.
I was NOT ready for that thunder and color swap! I say that as if I COULD be ready, which would have been absolutely impossible.
Did they want into the love hotel? Oh, it's a porn shop. Never mind, it IS a love hotel!
"A love hotel for my first time?! That sounds like something Kirin would do!"
"No comment."
I still think it's odd that Kirin of all people wanted the love hotel for her first time.
"But you're already so wet."
"How do you know that?!"
Busted!
Wtf? Why did she pay for it!? They are here to take shelter from the rain, not go into a love hotel room!
What did Uta need to do that required her to have 30 seconds without him looking her way? She's still dressed in the same clothes... Does she do a funny little dance or something? Clearly not enough time to masturbate so there's that.
Oh, she took of her underwear because horny...
I knew something was wrong with that sudden message interruption. Day by day I'm still surprised I can sense these things.
I had a sudden realization that leaving that early means she left something behind. This dude really went and came on her panties multiple times... I wonder how she would react knowing he saw them... and used them.
Yeah, this was extremely anticlimactic. She's barely reacting to the panties situation at all.
Wha-? So Uta got a mysterious message from someone and she doesn't know who it was but it made her react that badly!? She's been hiding something for a while now and I'm sort of concerned what this could imply. Have she been involved with sketchy people? Done things on impulse that gave them leverage somehow? Too soon to jump to conclusions but that is very cryptic...
Like I could go down the list of like, debt collector, owed money to drug dealers, unmentioned siblings being mistreated and she needs to use her money to keep them from being harmed further because she put them in that position to begin with... Like it could be a whole bunch of things.
It's interesting that this event is called "Uta-chan" and that she actually WILL talk about those things right now. Of course she's going to be less specific but it's a start I guess.
So far so good, nothing special about having had a stalker problem. That's kinda to be expected from both an idol and a maid cafe maid... or just attractive girls in general...
Okay she IS going to give the specifics. Relief.
Oh it's heating up. I believe I predicted in the past that her brother beat someone up who had something to do with Uta. That was the stalker.
Wait... Is there like a chance she was a famous idol or something in the past, did something impulsive, her brother got in jail for beating up the stalker, that made headlines and because she is the sister of someone in jail, she couldn't stay as an idol and was shamed BADLY for it and had to hide away in a different town to escape it all? ......... Holy fuck... Chills all over my body... It's starting to make sense now...
Omg, it's starting to make COMPLETE sense! HOLY FUCK!
Her parents are strict with her sexual misdeeds and have put parental control to stop Uta from impulsively sending nude photo's to strangers using her own name and face from when she was a kid to prevent more photos of her from spreading all over the internet and any time one more resurfaces, she has to leave whatever she's doing to deal with the issue before the images spread around more! A GIFT FROM ME TO YOU
SO MANY SONGS - EACH WITHOUT A CODA
YOU CAN NOT HIDE FROM THE PAST

Antosha said:
Again, fair. Matador was at least an actual response to something someone else had done (Yumi’s bullying of Futaba), instead of just being Nodoka inflicting the games in her head on other people (cf, everything else she does).

But while Yumi’s subsequent physical assault was out of proportion and from a legal and moral standpoint just plain wrong, it wasn’t premeditated. And she’s punished.

Nodoka’s “revenge” was massively over the top — and cold as hell. As Moonflare pointed out, she exacts it after Yumi has already stopped the bullying—Yumi even admits to Nodoka that it was wrong for her to pick on Futaba. Nodoka commits proxy sexual assault just because she can.

Also, it contained one of the first green path options I really had to hold my nose for.
Click to expand...
And I have no objection your honor; I won't defend for Nodoka's righteousness when there is none in a case like this, let alone endorse the level of revenge she dished out.

Why I framed my thought on Matador like that is because I believed there is more to Nodoka’s revenge on Yumi than just “because she can”, and that is a combination of hateful thoughts like “you haven’t really been taught a lesson for all you have done to my loved one yet”, “I will hurt you as much as I can, just like what you did to her”, "I need to see how sorry you actually are with my own eyes", and “even if Futaba’s forgiven you, I HAVE NOT” (the last one is especially prominent in my eyes because Futaba has always been a weakling softie, someone either incapable of or unwilling to properly hate and punish those that deserve, and constantly lets them off the hook way too easily). Even if they are self-centered or self-righteous, thoughts like these and the subsequent extreme vengeance make Nodoka a living human being for once. That is her human moment, even if it was revealed via a very very unnecessarily cruel segue.

If I, Fdsasdf Fukuyama, dear Futaba's imaginary siscon psychopath onichan, who's been worried sick about my timid imouto's bully issues and who's been wanting to stab Yumi 23 times for this had the opportunity came sooner, suddenly got told one day (by Futaba herself, no less) that it's all no problemo now with seemingly no tangible closure whatsoever. And that's it? How could she accept this? How could I accept this? How would I dissipate my anger that's been boiling ever since I found out your pain and suffering? Would I not do the same thing Nodoka did, or would I not do something even worse than Matador?

Everything up there is over the top, all of them. But when it comes to revenge stemmed from love too deep, twisted, and suffocating, rational and reasonable solutions are not a concern. Just for a brief moment, thoughts like those lower Nodoka's maliciousness meter from incomprehensible calamity to a mere directional cruel person, and that is all I ask because you really can't ask a tad more from Nodoka.

NULLWIZARD said:
I wrote a small mod that lets you skip the affection/lust point grind without having to go through the tedium of typing in cheat codes or having your save labelled with the cheater flag.

View attachment 1901303

Features:
  • Sets all girls' affection and lust points to a value X unless they were already higher than X
  • Can set a specific girl's love/lust points
  • Written to be future-proof (i.e. will automatically work for any new girls, you will never need to update the mod)
  • Enables the developer console
Usage Instructions:
  • Download the attached file
    • Note: if you get sent to a new tab with a bunch of text, just right click and hit "Save as" and name it as z_set_love_lust.rpy
  • Move into the folder named "game" (found inside the folder that you launch Lessons in Love from)
  • Load a save and open the developer console with Shift + O
  • Press Enter a few times until you can see the ">" symbol in the top left of the screen
  • To update all girls' love and lust: type setLoveAndLust(X) and press Enter(for an example, see the image below)
    • Note: X must be an integer (aka whole number)
  • To update a specific girl's love or lust, for example Ami: type "ami_love += X" and/or "ami_lust += X" without the quotation marks and then press Enter.
    • Note: the girl's name must be fully lower-case.
    • This will increase their love/lust by X. If you want to make it equal to X then omit the plus sign
  • Press Esc to close the console and now you can play!

Bonus stuff (not essential to read):

I recommend using this with the guide mod for max efficiency because other than grinding points, the main time-sink with this game is trying to trigger events.

If you want a version of the mod that lets you set affection and lust points separately (useful if you don't want to see any lust events), see here: https://f95zone.to/threads/lessons-in-love-v0-30-0-selebus.48158/post-10770605

Advice from alex2011 on how to use the mod so that you don't accidentally miss events (note: I used the mod myself with 50 affection from the start and didn't experience any issues. You can still miss events even if you follow the instructions below and you can still see all events while ignoring those instructions.):


Uninstall: delete the files z_set_love_lust.rpy and z_set_love_lust.rpyc from your game subfolder

I also made a mod that lets you scroll your mouse-wheel to simulate clicks (i.e. scrolling forward a bit makes the dialogue move forward by one mouse click), makes the game more convenient to play https://f95zone.to/threads/use-scroll-wheel-to-simulate-mouse-clicks.120507/#post-8406783
